title: Shrinks items by about 50% but makes them longer; supplied pump is useless
text:
Shrinks items by about 50% but makes them longer; supplied pump is useless. These bags DO NOT reduce volume by 80% as is claimed. Yes they do shrink the puffiness of a comforter and the comforter I put in the extra large bag shrunk by about 50% but it spread out longer to almost of the full size of the jumbo plastic bag.

WHAT'S PROVIDED (photo 1)
- 5 jumbo storage bags (about 35" x 47" or 90 x 120 CM)
- 5 large storage bags (about 28" x 39" or 70 x 100 CM)
- 1 hand pump

I inserted the comforter (photo 2) into the jumbo bag up to the fill line (photo 3). I then had a difficult time trying to seal the bag. It seals just like a regular sandwich bag and I kept having to re-seat the channels. I finally got it to seal. I then tried one vacuum hose to vacuum the bag. That did not work probably because the hose opening was angled. I then tried the hand pump. That is completely useless. Next I tried another vacuum hose and that worked. It flattened into what you see in photos 4 and 5. What it did was spread the item flat in the bag and comforter became hard and long. So far it has held the seal.

These bags appear to be strong, which is a plus compared to some others I tried. One king-sized down comforter fit in the jumbo bag up to the fill line and reduced the height by about 50% but did extend out the length a bit. The length extension is typical of any bags of this type. Overall, these appear to be good bags. However, their claims of reducing volume by 80% are over exaggerated and the supplied pump is completely useless.

description: Easy to Use: 4 Simple Steps to Save Space and Keep Your Closet Organized!

Ensure that everything you want to store is clean and completely dry. Open up the bag on a flat surface and undo the zip. Fold the materials and put them inside the bag carefully. Stack items on top of each other, but do not overfill. Make sure that there are a couple of centimeters spare from the edges of the clothes etc and the zip closure.

With the items in place, use the plastic clip to zip along sealing the two plastic zips. Go back over the zips to ensure it is fully sealed. The surest way is to run the clip fully from end to end in both directions, and then to run your hand along the whole length of the zip between finger and thumb to ensure that there’s no tiny section missed. Please be noted that the clip is not fixed by design, so don’t panic when it falls off.

When ready, undo the valve lid by unscrewing it, and then place the vacuum cleaner nozzle with no attachments on it over the valve. You simply need to press it against the valve, and then turn the vacuum on. It will then start to remove the air. You don’t need a perfect seal against the valve, but keep pressing it on firmly and the air will be extracted. Please be noted that

After vacuuming all the air out of the bag, stop and close the cap quickly to secure an air-tight seal. Listen carefully for any signs of air leaking out of the cap or other zipped parts of the bag. Repeat step 2 if necessary. If the bags are tightly sealed, congratulations, you can put them under your bed or wherever you think is suitable.
